component.name: Open Office Studio
component.summary: Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, notes, Access databases and email

description.p: This is a community package of Open Office Studio, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the OpenAEC Foundation. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Open Office Studio is a local office suite in one window. It opens and saves DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files directly, keeps notebooks of free-form or Markdown notes, opens Microsoft Access MDB and ACCDB databases as an editable SQLite working copy without changing the original, and includes an IMAP/SMTP email client. There is no account and no cloud service.

Upstream marks the app as under active development and publishes its releases as development builds; test it on copies of your files first. This package is the full suite. Upstream's single-module apps (Writer, Spreadsheet, Presentation, Email, Notition, Database) are the same modules in separate installs and are not packaged.

Sandbox: display, GPU, X11 for the clipboard, network for email, the keyring for email passwords, and the printer socket. Files are opened and saved through the file chooser. Opening legacy DOC, XLS and PPT files and ODF files needs a LibreOffice installation to convert them, which the sandbox cannot run; DOCX, XLSX and PPTX need nothing else. Updates come through FlatPark.
